player_prompt.intro:
We u Player {player_id} mu joga ya {num_rounds}-round ya Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Kulengwa kwenu ni kuwina vijiti vingi ivyo vikwete.
Mu kila joga, itikeni na moja ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
Mungayi kutumisa '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' kuwa kufupisha.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kutenda kwa joga hakutambulwa. Tumisani [rock], [paper], or [scissors].
